MATCH (p:Paper)-[:CITES]-(r:Paper)
RETURN r.name AS citedPaper, count(p) AS timesReferred
ORDER BY timesReferred DESC

MATCH (a:Author)-[:WROTE]-(p:Paper)
RETURN a.name AS author, count(p) AS paperCount
ORDER BY paperCount DESC

MATCH (p:Paper)-[:HAS_KEYWORD]->(k:Keyword),
      (p)-[:IN_VOLUME]->(v:Volume)-[:PUBLISHED_IN]->(y:PubYear)
WITH y.year AS year, k.name AS keyword, count(*) AS freq
ORDER BY year, freq DESC
WITH year, collect({k: keyword, freq: freq})[0..3] AS top_keywords
UNWIND top_keywords AS kw
RETURN year, kw.k AS keyword, kw.freq AS frequency
ORDER BY year, frequency DESC;

MATCH (v:Volume)
OPTIONAL MATCH (v)<-[:IN_VOLUME]-(p:Paper)-[:CITES]->(q:Paper)-[:IN_VOLUME]->(other:Volume)
WHERE v <> other
WITH v, count(DISTINCT other) AS out_links
OPTIONAL MATCH (v)<-[:IN_VOLUME]-(q:Paper)<-[:CITES]-(p:Paper)-[:IN_VOLUME]->(other2:Volume)
WHERE v <> other2
WITH v, out_links + count(DISTINCT other2) AS total_links
RETURN
  sum(CASE WHEN total_links = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS isolated_volumes,
  sum(CASE WHEN total_links > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS connected_volumes,
  count(v) AS total_volumes;

MATCH (v1:Volume)<-[i:IN_VOLUME]-(p1:Paper)-[c:CITES]->(p2:Paper)-[i2:IN_VOLUME]->(v2:Volume)
WHERE id(v1) < id(v2)
WITH v1, v2, count(*) AS num_citazioni, i, p1, c, p2, i2
RETURN v1 AS source, v2 AS target, num_citazioni, i, p1, c, p2, i2
LIMIT 10;
